title: Beyond-Birthday Security for Key-Masked SoKAC21
summary: The reported birthday attack on SoKAC21 does not work against its key-masked variant, while proving beyond-birthday security for that variant remains open.

formal_statement.body: Consider the variant of SoKAC21 obtained by masking its final output with a key, itself a variant of sum-of-key alternating ciphers. The birthday attack on SoKAC21 does not work against this key-masked-output variant. The open problem is to prove beyond-birthday security for the variant.

scope.domain: Security analysis of symmetric cryptographic constructions, specifically a key-masked-output variant of SoKAC21 among sum-of-key alternating ciphers.
parameters: masking key: masks the final output to form the analyzed variant
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove beyond-birthday security for the key-masked-output variant.

citations.label: Mind the Composition: Birthday Bound Attacks on EWCDMD and SoKAC21

progress.summary: The paper reports a birthday attack on SoKAC21 and notes that the attack does not work when the final output is masked with a key. It presents proving beyond-birthday security for the resulting variant as an open problem.
citation_labels: Mridul Nandi et al., Mind the Composition: Birthday Bound Attacks on EWCDMD and SoKAC21
